Name: Get App Builder Updates
Description: System Workflow to Check for PAA Updates

Actions.Description: Check if app is marked as Development
Clear tables before getting new entries

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
-- Clear Updates table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates

-- Clear Hotfixes table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes

-- Clear Specific Updates table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates

-- Clear Add-ons table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Addons

-- Clear Cumulative Hotfixes Package table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes

-- Clear Cumulative Hotfixes table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM paa.Updates_Cumulative

Actions.Description: Create List from JSON for Updates

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates (Title, DnnFriendlyName, Version, CreatedDate)
VALUES (@Title, @DnnFriendlyName, @Version, GetDate())

Actions.Description: Create List and insert new hotfixes

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes (FeatureType, ChangeType, Date, Version, DnnFriendlyName, Details, InstalledVersion, ProductID, Link, State, CreatedDate, Priority)
VALUES (@FeatureType, @ChangeType, @Date, @Version, @DnnFriendlyName, @Details, @InstalledVersion, @ProductID, @Link, @State, GetDate(), @Priority)

Actions.Description: Create List and insert new specific updates

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates (Product, Version, Info, Link, State, CreatedDate, Priority)
VALUES (@Product, @Version, @Info, @Link, @State, GetDate(), @Priority)

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Addons (DnnFriendlyName, Code, Title, Version, Description, Link, CreatedDate)
VALUES (@DnnFriendlyName, @Code, @Title, @Version, @Description, @Link, GetDate())

Actions.Description: Fetch Cumulative Hotfixes and save on the internal tables

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery

Actions.Description: For each package, compare the installed version with the hotfix version and check if it's lower
Version is not zero and package can be installed
Add package and connect to Cumulative Hotfix bundle

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery

Actions.Description: Cleanup Cumulative Hotfix entry, if there are no packages

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes
    WHERE CumulativeId = @Id
)
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM paa.Updates_Cumulative
    WHERE Id = @Id;
END
